summary: Iteration 63 — Verified Draft/Saved/Sent-only quote status workflow + new Load Quote modal layout. All 6 backend pytest tests passed and all 7 frontend Playwright assertions passed.

backend: PATCH status=sent stamps sent_at; preserved on saved→sent re-transition
POST /api/quotes status=sent returns non-null sent_at + created_at
GET /api/quotes returns created_at and sent_at on rows
frontend: Toolbar status dropdown lists EXACTLY: draft, saved, sent (no won/lost/hold)
Load Quote modal Saved-tab header shows: Est #, Customer, Owner, Created, Updated, Pricing Version, Status, Actions
Sent quote shows data-testid='load-time-to-send-{id}' sublabel (e.g. '0m to send')
StatusPill icons: Pencil (draft, grey rgb(156,163,175)), Save (saved, amber rgb(217,119,6)), CheckCircle (sent, green rgb(22,163,74))
Created and Updated cells show date + time (e.g. '6/29/26, 7:09 PM')
Est # cell uses 11px font (smaller) and shows full estimate number (no ellipsis truncation)
Toolbar status dot color updates: saved → rgb(245,158,11) amber, sent → rgb(16,185,129) green
